subject: Geozonal hosting commitment + private connector plan for CareVista
messages:
From: Anna Patel <anna.patel@carevistahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: CareVista Security <security@carevistahealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@CSP-partner.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Geozonal hosting question

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday. Our security team asked for two concrete commitments before we can proceed to procurement: 1) an explicit statement of where customer data will be hosted for our account (primary and failover geozones for US-only deployments), and 2) details on how the private connector (Privatelink/VPC peering) will ensure traffic never traverses public internet paths.

Can you provide a short commitment letter and the network diagram your engineering team will use for on-boarding? Also, if you can confirm whether KMS keys for tenant encryption can be scoped to a US-only HSM region, that would help our compliance reviewer.

Appreciate it—Anna

--
Anna Patel
Director, Platform Security
CareVista Health
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Patel <anna.patel@carevistahealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Geozonal hosting question

Anna—

Thanks for outlining the asks. I've looped in Irene (privacy & compliance) and Jordan (deployments) to confirm details. Quick summary of what we can provide immediately:

- Hosting commitment: Redwood will serve CareVista production traffic from the US West (primary) with automated failover to US East only. No customer production data will be routed or stored in EU/APAC for this account unless explicitly requested and contracted.
- Private connectivity: We support AWS PrivateLink and dedicated VPC peering. Traffic between CareVista and Redwood inference instances will traverse the private VPC endpoint; we will not route inference request/response traffic over the public internet.
- KMS scope: Customers can bring a KMS key (BYOK) with regional restrictions; Redwood can also provision customer-owned keys in a US-only KMS/HSM arrangement for tenant-level encryption.

I'll attach the hosting zone matrix and the connector diagram. Irene/Jordan—can you validate and add any required legal/compliance phrasing we should include in the commitment letter?

Thanks,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Anna Patel <anna.patel@carevistahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Geozonal hosting question

Anna / team—

We reviewed Marcus's summary and added the language CareVista asked for. Key points in the attached commitment letter:

1) Geozonal hosting declaration with primary (us-west-2) and failover (us-east-1) described by service boundaries.
2) Privacy-safe KV caching: cached model KV is encrypted at rest and rotated; we will not persist request payloads beyond short inference caching windows unless configured by the customer.
3) Network controls: the PrivateLink connector enforces source-cidrs limited to your VPC and uses mutual TLS between endpoints; we include a fallback routing policy that returns errors (not fallback over public internet) if private connectivity is unavailable.
4) KMS/HSM: support for customer-managed keys with a US region scoping requirement; we accept external keys via standard BYOK flows and can evidence key residency during audit.

We also answered the SIG/CAIQ questions relevant to hosting and key management in the attached PDF. Jordan/Marissa, please confirm the diagram aligns with the deployment runbook and the planned onboarding window (we typically have a 3-week schedule for PrivateLink + KMS key validation).

Regards,
Irene

--
Irene Choi
Head of Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Anna Patel <anna.patel@carevistahealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T11:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Geozonal hosting question

Anna—following up with the runbook timeline. Proposed onboarding milestones:

- Week 0: Exchange network CIDRs, sign the Private Connectivity Acknowledgement (we've included a short two‑pager).
- Week 1: Provision Privatelink endpoint on your side and our side; smoke test routing between test VPCs.
- Week 2: KMS BYOK integration + key provenance verification; SOC2 evidence handover for audit items related to key management.
- Week 3: Production cutover and final verification (latency checks, failover simulation).

If CareVista needs a longer runbook for change control, we can extend any milestone. We'll also provide a controlled test harness so you can validate that no data leaves the US zones during failover simulations.

Action items for Anna: confirm target week for kickoff and provide the three CIDR blocks your network team will dedicate.

Thanks,
Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Anna Patel <anna.patel@carevistahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: CareVista Security <security@carevistahealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Geozonal hosting question

Team—

This looks great and addresses the security review's top items. We will:
- Send the three CIDR blocks by EOD Monday.
- Review the SOC2/SIG answers in the PDF and follow up with any clarifying questions.
- Request that the commitment letter include an explicit line that Redwood will not replicate production inference payloads to any non-US storage for this CareVista account without prior written approval.

Can you add that sentence and re-upload the commitment letter to the Drive folder you shared? Also, please include the DocuSign link for the Private Connectivity Acknowledgement when ready so procurement can sign.

Best,
Anna

--
Anna Patel
Director, Platform Security
CareVista Health
